```json
{
  "code": "import json\nimport pathlib\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\n# Load input data\ndata = json.loads(pathlib.Path('inputs/task.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))\n\n# Separate current and previous batches\ncurrent_rows = [r for r in data if r['is_current']]\nprevious_rows = [r for r in data if not r['is_current']]\n\n# Build site aggregates for current and previous\ncurrent_aggregates = defaultdict(lambda: {'request_count': 0, 'failed_request_count': 0, 'latency_sum_ms': 0, 'event_locator': ''})\nfor row in current_rows:\n    site_id = row['site_id']\n    current_aggregates[site_id]['request_count'] += row['request_count']\n    current_aggregates[site_id]['failed_request_count'] += row['failed_request_count']\n    current_aggregates[site_id]['latency_sum_ms'] += row['latency_sum_ms']\n    if row['event_locator']:\n        current_aggregates[site_id]['event_locator'] = row['event_locator']\n\nprevious_aggregates = defaultdict(lambda: {'exceeds_slo': False})\nfor row in previous_rows:\n    site_id = row['site_id']\n    request_count = row['request_count']\n    failed_request_count = row['failed_request_count']\n    if request_count > 0:\n        error_rate = failed_request_count / request_count\n        previous_aggregates[site_id]['exceeds_slo'] = error_rate > row['slo_error_rate']\n\n# Build output rows\noutput_rows = []\nfor site_id in sorted(current_aggregates.keys()):\n    agg = current_aggregates[site_id]\n    request_count = agg['request_count']\n    failed_request_count = agg['failed_request_count']\n    latency_sum_ms = agg['latency_sum_ms']\n    error_rate_pct = round(100 * failed_request_count / request_count, 4) if request_count > 0 else 0\n    mean_latency_ms = round(latency_sum_ms / request_count, 4) if request_count > 0 else 0\n    slo_error_rate = next((r['slo_error_rate'] for r in current_rows if r['site_id'] == site_id), 0)\n    exceeds_slo = (failed_request_count / request_count) > slo_error_rate if request_count > 0 else False\n\n    prior_exceeds_slo = previous_aggregates[site_id]['exceeds_slo'] if site_id in previous_aggregates else None\n\n    if prior_exceeds_slo is None:\n        risk_change = 'initial'\n    else:\n        if exceeds_slo and not prior_exceeds_slo:\n            risk_change = 'new'\n        elif not exceeds_slo and prior_exceeds_slo:\n            risk_change = 'resolved'\n        elif exceeds_slo and prior_exceeds_slo:\n            risk_change = 'still_risk'\n        else:\n            risk_change = 'still_clear'\n\n    event_locator = agg['event_locator']\n\n    output_rows.append({\n        'site_id': site_id,\n        'request_count': request_count,\n        'failed_request_count': failed_request_count,\n        'error_rate_pct': error_rate_pct,\n        'mean_latency_ms': mean_latency_ms,\n        'exceeds_slo': exceeds_slo,\n        'risk_change': risk_change,\n        'event_locator': event_locator\n    })\n\n# Write output\npathlib.Path('outputs/result.json').write_text(json.dumps(output_rows, separators=(',', ':')))
}
```
